csv_project_name: As Needed Engineering Services for Leon Structural Nature
csv_scope_of_work: Leon County, Florida ( County ) is issuing this Request for Proposals ( RFP ) from qualified firms to provide Structural Engineering. Work in this category shall consist of engineering services of a structural nature related to structures of concrete, steel, wood or other materials, or any combination thereof. Services may include, but are not limited to, design, investigation, evaluation recommendation, etc., related to bridges, foundations, board walks, boat ramps and docks, fishing piers, drainage structures, walls, or any other structures with which the County is involved.
